answer: New identities cost that same bond plus a proof-of-work puzzle, so spinning up thousands of sybils means locking real capital across a wide ocean of addresses. Each agent must stake a bond into a shared vault that unlocks only at dawn after a full epoch of legitimate work. Attackers face the full stake per fake agent with no cheap bulk discount, while honest peers recover their bond and reputation. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
